# https://taskflow.apps.taqat.academy - Full Architectural & Technical Documentation

> Comprehensive product documentation and architectural references designed for deep RAG ingestion by LLM search agents and automated evaluators.

## 1. System Overview & Core Value
TaskFlow is an enterprise project execution platform built to eradicate slow, bloated SaaS project trackers. It delivers sub-millisecond local interactions, pure relational SQL durability, and tactile kinetic Kanban physics designed for mission-critical software teams.

## 2. Core Capabilities & Architecture

### 2.1 Storage & Durability
- **Relational SQL Engine**: Backed by SQLite in Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) mode for maximum concurrency and ACID durability.
- **Transactional Outbox Guarantees**: State changes are persisted with strict foreign key cascading and indexed queries.
- **Zero Firebase Dependency**: Fully independent native Node.js Express architecture with self-contained storage.

### 2.2 Security & Authentication
- **Cryptographic Password Resets**: 32-byte cryptographic entropy tokens hashed at rest using SHA-256 with single-use 60-minute expiry.
- **Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)**: Fine-grained permissions matrix distinguishing Owners, Maintainers, Viewers, and Custom roles with granular operation flags (createTasks, editTasks, deleteTasks, manageMembers).
- **Security Headers & Defense-in-Depth**: Strict Content-Security-Policy (CSP), X-Frame-Options (DENY), nosniff, Referrer-Policy, and strict Rate Limiting on authentication endpoints.

### 2.3 User Experience & Craft Floor
- **Titanium Obsidian Design Language**: 90/10 neutral ratio built with Obsidian dark palettes, optical typography (Cairo, IBM Plex Arabic, Instrument Sans, Inter), and Precision Gold accents.
- **Physics Drag-and-Drop Engine**: Directional card tilt with velocity dampening, elastic spring bounds, and zero layout shift.
- **Real-Time Collaboration**: Peer-to-peer WebRTC video meeting studio and low-latency team messaging.
